data.one_liner: Triggers official Google Play In-App Updates on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: Enables Flutter applications on Android to check for and execute in-app updates using the official Google Play Core APIs. It supports both immediate (full-screen) and flexible (background download) update flows. It provides metadata like staleness, priority, and update availability directly from the Play Store.
use_when: Distributing an Android app via Google Play and wanting to prompt or force users to update without leaving the app
Implementing background flexible downloads or immediate critical update flows on Android
avoid_when: Building for iOS, desktop, or web, as the official API is Android-only and throws not-implemented exceptions
Distributing via third-party stores or sideloading, since it requires the Google Play Store
strengths: Direct wrapper around official Google Play Core In-App Update APIs
Supports both immediate and flexible update workflows
Exposes update metadata such as staleness days and priority
weaknesses: Android-only; calling methods on iOS causes not-implemented exceptions
Cannot be tested locally outside of Google Play tracks
data.setup_notes: Requires Android API 21+ and must be tested via Google Play (e.g., internal testing track).
